notes.title: Connection Solutions and Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused the player to disconnect from the game.
 Fixed a bug that prevented some interactive UI s from appearing.


Now when you get the keys, you can see which key you have by pressing the "J"  key. "Create Room" is active again.

If you encounter bugs in the game or want to make suggestions, please visit our discord channel; Mirror Spirits Discord Channel
